note: Shared V514 Team Building Checks parity fixture. Inputs from the website's data (meta-doubles.json of 2026-09-25, Top 30); `context` and `expect` are computed by the app, which is the source of truth. Teams: `owner` and `cluster` are the two worked examples; `slow` is a Speed cluster outside the range the Top X contests, `pair` is the two-Pokemon single-lead-pair case, `nometa` is the same six as `cluster` judged with NO Top Meta (see `no_context_teams`), and `gatedresist` / `gatedboth` are the two Shared Weakness green branches where a type IS shared by three or more: one excused by the team's own switch-ins alone (Psychic, which the Top 30 attacks with at 1.4x the average rate) and one where neither the switch-ins nor the below-average rate would be enough on its own (Fairy). Regenerate with tests/gen_team_check_fixture_v514.py in the Companion repository, which writes both copies and prints the fixture_id both suites assert.
